response.text:
I need to know the hours schema in /business, which isn't shown. Currently it's {"$placeholder":"hours"}. I have to guess the format. A likely structure is an array of day/opens/closes objects, but without the schema that is risky. A common pattern is {"mon":[{"open":"08:00","close":"16:00"}],...}. I'll use that: keys mon–sun, with a value of an array of intervals, and an empty array for closed days.

I'll also add an opening-hours section to the homepage after the contact strip, since the hours are now available, and to the contact page? The contact component already shows hours, so only the homepage needs it. The contact-strip also shows hours, so a separate section is not needed. I'll change only /business/hours.

Saturday and Sunday: the client didn't say, so I'll leave them as closed with empty arrays, which is the natural reading of "uradne ure".
